settings.heading: Materials & Craft
settings.content: Hand-cut from natural stone and glass tesserae, assembled tile by tile by master artisans. Mounted on a fiber-mesh backing for easy installation. Each piece is unique; slight variation in color and texture is part of its handmade character.

settings.heading: Shipping & Returns
settings.content: Made to order with a 4–5 week handling time, then shipped free worldwide via DHL, UPS or FedEx with full tracking (transit around 10 days). Carefully packed in thick paper and heavy-duty film. Covered by our 30-day returns policy and lifetime warranty.

settings.question: Are your mosaics weatherproof and waterproof?
settings.answer: Yes — every mosaic is fully weatherproof and waterproof, made from durable natural stone and glass. They're suitable for indoor and outdoor spaces, including pools, bathrooms and kitchens.

settings.question: What is the production and shipping time?
settings.answer: Each mosaic is handcrafted to order with a 4–5 week handling time, then transit typically takes around 10 days, shipped free worldwide with full tracking.

settings.question: Can I order a custom size or design?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Use the Request a Quote form to share your dimensions or your own image, and our artisans will hand-cut a one-of-a-kind piece tailored to your space.
